# Third-party and artwork notices

The original Ally Ahead application code and documentation are covered by the root [MIT License](../LICENSE). These notices preserve third-party licenses, which continue to apply to their respective components. No trademark rights are granted.

Pi is pinned to `@earendil-works/pi-agent-core`, `pi-ai`, and `pi-coding-agent` **1.4.0**. They are used via their public SDK APIs without copying/modifying Pi core. [Upstream v1.4.0 MIT license](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/LICENSE), copyright Mario Zechner, is retained in `PI_LICENSE.txt`; this covers the related Pi monorepo packages whose npm tarballs omit a standalone license file. No personal Pi configuration, models or credentials are included.

`DEPENDENCIES.json` records the 266 installed packages, exact versions, declared SPDX expression and source repository. `DEPENDENCY_NOTICES.txt` preserves available package license/copyright/NOTICE files. Regenerate with `node scripts/dependency-notices.mjs` after an independent frozen install. [SUPPLEMENTAL_NOTICES.txt](SUPPLEMENTAL_NOTICES.txt) retains README-embedded and shared upstream license texts for packages whose tarballs omit standalone notices; [SUPPLEMENTAL_LICENSE_SOURCES.json](SUPPLEMENTAL_LICENSE_SOURCES.json) records package versions, sources and hashes. Pi packages use `PI_LICENSE.txt`. The JavaScript `standardwebhooks` package uses the upstream `libraries/LICENSE` MIT license. Keep these supplemental files when regenerating the installed-package inventory. The lockfile pins tarball integrities. This initial inventory includes macOS optional build/parser binaries; other platforms may add their respective optional packages.

Key licenses: React, Express, Zod, marked, Turndown, pg and TypeScript are permissively licensed; PDF.js is Apache-2.0, Mammoth is BSD-2-Clause, and Pi is MIT. JSZip offers `MIT OR GPL-3.0-or-later`; this POC uses the MIT option. Lightning CSS and its unmodified optional build binary declare MPL-2.0; preserve their notices and upstream source link/version if redistributing those tools. They are build dependencies, not modified application sources. No GPL-only project license is inferred.

PayPal's JavaScript SDK is fetched from PayPal only after explicit checkout consent; it is not vendored or relicensed here. REST traffic is pinned to Sandbox. PayPal trademarks remain their owners'. Public case company names are factual citations, without company logos or source images. The catalog contains original project summaries, not republished articles; see `docs/CASE_SOURCES.md`.

See [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md) for the complete bundled artwork inventory, origin and licensing scope. Public case citations and external services do not grant rights to third-party articles, images, logos or trademarks.
